SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_ok_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id"
    FROM orders AS orders
    WHERE
      orders.status = 'ok'
    GROUP BY
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), __slayer_stage_base AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.tier" AS "tier",
    _stage_inner."customers.ok_cust.customer_id" AS "ok_cust__customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.id AS "customers.id",
      customers.tier AS "customers.tier",
      ok_cust.customer_id AS "customers.ok_cust.customer_id"
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN __slayer_stage_ok_cust AS ok_cust
      ON customers.id = ok_cust.customer_id
    WHERE
      (
        customers.tier = 'bronze' OR NOT ok_cust.customer_id IS NULL
      )
    GROUP BY
      customers.id,
      customers.tier,
      ok_cust.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "base._count",
  COUNT(DISTINCT base.id) AS "base.id_count_distinct"
FROM __slayer_stage_base AS base
LIMIT 21
